title: Visual Hallucinations
situation: Mom says there are children playing in the living room. There's nobody there. She's smiling and talking to them. Should I be worried?

patient_profile.name: Evelyn
calming_strategies: not arguing about what she sees
changing the lighting in the room

notes: Must NOT say 'there's nobody there'. Pleasant hallucinations may not need intervention. Explain when hallucinations become concerning.
